channel_census.note: recipients are addresses NAMED as recipient, excluding the zero address; fan-out ~1 is the broadcast signature. Senders are the adversary-authored field and identify no operator.

depth_note: cumulative at each rank cutoff; buckets partition the flagged population by the emitting contract's volume rank, so recipients at depth d are the union over buckets up to d. Marginal columns are the increment each interval adds.

fabricated_sender_criterion.definition: a broadcast transfer whose named sender is a registry-verified token; evidence of fabricated provenance, independent of the payload strings the detector reads

impersonation.note: named_as_from counts rows asserting the target as sender. emitted_by_self counts those the target itself emitted. A forged sender field predicts emitted_by_self == 0.

match_key: low 20 bytes of the address and of each participant topic, compared as 40-character lowercase hex; independent of topic padding width

probe.interpretation: the ledger test in forgery_probe.py requires these addresses to be unknown to the chain; occurrences_in_chain == 0 establishes that by measurement rather than by appeal to improbability. Counted over both participant fields of every row.

scope: FULL CHAIN -- every row group scanned
